text:
elaine: Quick sync: several SIs are routing leads differently. We need a compact playbook for handoffs, SLA, and credit splits so forecasting + comp are stable. Thoughts? :memo:

matt: +1. Can we keep it simple for the first 30-day pilot? Two decision axes: ARR estimate and whether SI ran a demo/proof.

carlos: Ops POV: anything that affects who is owner in SFDC must be deterministic. We keep getting split ownerships and stale queues.

elaine: Proposed pilot rules (short):
1) Referral (ARR < $30k or internal PoC): SI owns opp for 45 days, logs activities weekly.
2) Co-sell (ARR $30k-$200k): AE becomes primary owner in SFDC, SI listed as partner contact; both get pipeline credit (split below).
3) Strategic (>$200k or existing contract+expansion): Redwood sales owns; SI gets referral credit and named support.

anya: Add a tie-breaker: if SI completes a product demo and provides a technical win doc, bump to Co-sell even if ARR estimate low. That avoids losing deals where SI did heavy lifting.

matt: Good call. Also: if Redwood has an active contract or an existing renewal in next 12 months, Redwood retains ownership regardless.

sami: Intake form change proposal: capture ARR bucket (choosable), demo_done (checkbox), tech_win_link (url), procurement_timeline, SI_name, SI_sales_rep. I'll spin a PR.

carlos: SFDC automation suggestion (example rule):
```
IF demo_done = true AND ARR_bucket IN ("<30k","30-200k") THEN set Ownership = "Co-sell", set PartnerContact = SI_sales_rep
ELSE IF ARR_bucket = "<30k" THEN set Ownership = "SI-only"
ELSE set Ownership = "Redwood"
```
Note: will need manual override flag for edge cases.

julia: On credits/comp: for pilot recommend default splits: SI-only = 75% credit to SI, Co-sell = 60% AE / 40% SI for pipeline reporting (we can reverse if SI brings most technical work). Enterprise = handled by sales-ops. Need a clear process for disputes.

elaine: Dispute process: open a short form (sales-ops) within 7 days of ownership change. Ops adjudicates within 5 business days and posts ruling to a shared ledger.

matt: I'll draft the SFDC field list and the zap mapping: new fields `partner_role`, `partner_demo_url`, `intake_bucket`, `ownership_reason`, `ownership_effective_date`. Also add simple workflow to notify both AE and SI when ownership changes.

ops-bot: New Confluence page created: https://confluence.redwood.example.com/display/Partners/CoSell+Handoff+Playbook (view: partnerships, sales)

anya: Propose a weekly triage (Fri 9am PT) to sweep ambiguous intakes (ARRs near thresholds or missing demo doc). Keep it 25 minutes.

sami: I made a light-weight intake form PR: https://git.redwood.example.com/partnerships/si-intake/pull/105 (adds ARR bucket + demo_done + tech_win_link).

julia: Looping in sales-ops@redwood and comp-ops to confirm the 60/40 split for co-sell pilot works for quota reporting.

carlos: Ops ETA to add fields and automation: 3 business days after the PR merges. Will coordinate with matt for the Zap change.

matt: I'll add the notify flow and tests. Also adding a small sanity check job that flags ownership churn >2 times per opp.

elaine: Great. Plan: start pilot Monday, run 30 days, measure: time-to-ownership, % disputed credits, and percent of intakes missing demo docs. We'll reconvene in 30 days with metrics. Thanks all. :rocket:
